results.title: Swanand Kirkire reveals Sooraj Barjatya was impressed with his performance in Panchayat
results.description: Mumbai Nov 26 Actorsinger Swanand Kirkire shared that it was his performance in the series Panchayat that helped him came on board for Sooraj Barjatyaâs upcoming film Yeh Prem Mol Liya Kirkireâs performance as Sansaad Ji in the series Panchayat convinced the filmmaker of his acting abilities and helped him secure a pivotal role in the filmRecalling how the casting came about Kirkire shared that when Mukesh Chhabra suggested his name to Sooraj Barjatya for an important role in Yeh Prem Mol Liya the filmmaker was initially a little unsure about casting him as an actorTalking about the experience Kirkire said âSooraj ji has always been very fond of my songs and my work as a lyricist but when Mukesh Chhabra suggested my name for Yeh Prem Mol Liya I think he was initially a little unsure about me as an actor He had not really seen much of my acting work However when he watched me as Sansaad Ji in Panchayat he was quite impressed with my performanceâHe added âThat is when he immediately gave his nod and confirmed my casting in the film It was a lovely feeling because someone like Sooraj ji who has such a distinct understanding of cinema and performances trusted me with a pivotal role after watching my work It made the opportunity even more special for meâYeh Prem Mol Liya stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari in the lead roles with Anupam Kher Supriya Pathak Seema Pahwa Saumya Tandon Shaad Randhawa and Swanand Kirkire in supporting rolesThe film follows two people who fall in love and face family expectations misunderstandings and a twist on traditional marriage roles as they figure out what love and respect really mean Swanand won the National Film Award for Best Lyrics twice first in 2006 for the song Bande Me Tha DumVande Mataram from the film Lage Raho Munna Bhai and then in 2009for the song Behti Hawa Sa Tha Woh from the film 3 Idiots In 2018 at the 66th National Film Awards he won the National Film Award for Best Supporting Actor for the Marathi film Chumbak He made a cameo appearance as Sansad ji in Panchayat 3 and as Mansoor Khan Sahab in Qala to whose soundtrack he also contributed as a lyricist and singer IANS

results.title: Abhishek Kumar, Ankit Gupta complete 9th and 10th Jyotirlinga darshan, say ‘2 more to go’
results.description: Mumbai, Nov 26 (IANS) Television actors Abhishek Kumar and Ankit Gupta are soaking in spiritual bliss as they complete the darshan of the 9th and 10th Jyotirlingas, Mallikarjuna and Rameshwaram. Sharing glimpses from their spiritual journey, the actors expressed gratitude and said that the peace and contentment they experience at these sacred shrines are unmatched. Abhishek and Ankit shared in a collaborative post wrote: “Completed 9th and 10th Jyotirlingas, Mallikarjuna and Rameshwaram. Two more to go. Jitna sukoon aur shanti inse milke milti hai woh kahin nahi milti. Thank you God for everything. Har Har Mahadev. Feeling blessed.” Mallikarjuna Swamy Temple is dedicated to the deities Shiva and Parvati. It is significant to the Hindu sects of both Shaivism and Shaktism as this temple is referred to as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Shiva. Custom Ad: Multiplex Shiva is worshiped as Mallikarjuna and is represented by the lingam. His consort Parvati is depicted as Bhramaramba. The Rameswaram Jyotinga is enshrined at the Arulmigu Ramanathaswamy Temple on Rameswaram Island in Tamil Nadu, India, serving as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas. As per legends, Lord Rama worshipped Shiva here to atone for killing Ravana. Abhishek is best known for Udaariyaan, Bekaboo, and finishing as the first runner-up on Bigg Boss 17. He was also seen in , Khatron Ke Khiladi 14, Laughter Chefs, and Tere Mere Beech Mein. Meanwhile, Ankit is best known for his roles in Sadda Haq, Begusarai, Udaariyaan, Junooniyatt and Maati Se Bandhi Dor. In 2022, he participated in Bigg Boss 16. He made his acting debut in 2012 as Dr. Abhishek Kumar in Balika Vadhu. He was then seen portraying the character of Nalender Yadav in the Hindi film Tutiya Dil. He is currently seen in the television show Maati Se Bandhi Dor, which also stars actress Rutuja Bagwe. --IANS dc/
